definitions.gloss: elasticity; stretchiness; ability to stretch and contract
definitions.explanation: The quality of being able to stretch and spring back, as in fabric, rubber, or other materials. Common in clothing descriptions and product specifications.

examples.english: It uses a highly elastic material, so it doesn't feel tight even when you sit for a long time.
